
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xhzhang/p/19300477" title="发布于 2025-12-03 09:33">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">ELK日志分析平台搭建实战：从日志混乱到一目了然</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<blockquote>
<p>以前查日志：SSH登录服务器，grep、tail、awk轮番上阵，10台服务器查一圈下来半小时过去了。现在：打开Kibana，输入关键词，所有服务器的日志一秒出结果。</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="一为什么需要elk">一、为什么需要ELK？</h2>
<p>先说说我们之前的"原始"日志管理：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># 服务器1
ssh root@192.168.1.10
tail -f /var/log/app/app.log | grep "ERROR"

# 服务器2
ssh root@192.168.1.11
tail -f /var/log/app/app.log | grep "ERROR"

# 服务器3...10
# 开10个终端窗口...
</code></pre>
<p><strong>痛点：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>10台服务器要开10个终端</li>
<li>日志量大的时候grep到眼花</li>
<li>想看历史日志？先下载再分析</li>
<li>跨服务追踪？基本不可能</li>
<li>老板问"昨天有多少报错"？数到明天也数不完</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>搭了ELK之后：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>所有服务器日志集中一处</li>
<li>搜索秒出结果</li>
<li>自动生成图表</li>
<li>异常告警自动通知</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2 id="二elk是什么">二、ELK是什么？</h2>
<p>ELK是三个开源项目的首字母：</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>组件</th>
<th>作用</th>
<th>一句话解释</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td><strong>E</strong>lasticsearch</td>
<td>存储+搜索</td>
<td>日志数据库，支持全文搜索</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>L</strong>ogstash</td>
<td>收集+处理</td>
<td>从各处收集日志，清洗后存入ES</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td><strong>K</strong>ibana</td>
<td>可视化</td>
<td>Web界面，搜索和做图表</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p>现在还经常加个Filebeat，变成<strong>EFK</strong>或<strong>ELFK</strong>：</p>
<pre><code>应用日志 → Filebeat（轻量采集）→ Logstash（处理）→ Elasticsearch（存储）→ Kibana（展示）
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="三快速搭建docker-compose">三、快速搭建（Docker Compose）</h2>
<h3 id="31-服务器要求">3.1 服务器要求</h3>
<p>ELK比较吃资源，建议配置：</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>环境</th>
<th>CPU</th>
<th>内存</th>
<th>磁盘</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>测试</td>
<td>2核</td>
<td>4GB</td>
<td>50GB</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>生产</td>
<td>8核+</td>
<td>16GB+</td>
<td>500GB+ SSD</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3 id="32-目录结构">3.2 目录结构</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash">mkdir -p /data/elk/{elasticsearch,logstash,kibana}
cd /data/elk

# 目录结构
elk/
├── docker-compose.yml
├── elasticsearch/
│   └── data/
├── logstash/
│   ├── config/
│   │   └── logstash.yml
│   └── pipeline/
│       └── logstash.conf
└── kibana/
    └── config/
        └── kibana.yml
</code></pre>
<h3 id="33-docker-composeyml">3.3 docker-compose.yml</h3>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">version: '3.8'

services:
  elasticsearch:
    image: docker.elastic.co/elasticsearch/elasticsearch:8.11.0
    container_name: elasticsearch
    environment:
      - node.name=es01
      - cluster.name=elk-cluster
      - discovery.type=single-node
      - bootstrap.memory_lock=true
      - xpack.security.enabled=false
      - "ES_JAVA_OPTS=-Xms2g -Xmx2g"
    ulimits:
      memlock:
        soft: -1
        hard: -1
    volumes:
      - ./elasticsearch/data:/usr/share/elasticsearch/data
    ports:
      - "9200:9200"
    networks:
      - elk

  logstash:
    image: docker.elastic.co/logstash/logstash:8.11.0
    container_name: logstash
    volumes:
      - ./logstash/config/logstash.yml:/usr/share/logstash/config/logstash.yml
      - ./logstash/pipeline:/usr/share/logstash/pipeline
    ports:
      - "5044:5044"   # Beats输入
      - "5000:5000"   # TCP输入
      - "9600:9600"   # API
    environment:
      - "LS_JAVA_OPTS=-Xms512m -Xmx512m"
    depends_on:
      - elasticsearch
    networks:
      - elk

  kibana:
    image: docker.elastic.co/kibana/kibana:8.11.0
    container_name: kibana
    volumes:
      - ./kibana/config/kibana.yml:/usr/share/kibana/config/kibana.yml
    ports:
      - "5601:5601"
    environment:
      - ELASTICSEARCH_HOSTS=http://elasticsearch:9200
    depends_on:
      - elasticsearch
    networks:
      - elk

networks:
  elk:
    driver: bridge
</code></pre>
<h3 id="34-配置文件">3.4 配置文件</h3>
<p><strong>logstash/config/logstash.yml：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">http.host: "0.0.0.0"
xpack.monitoring.elasticsearch.hosts: ["http://elasticsearch:9200"]
</code></pre>
<p><strong>logstash/pipeline/logstash.conf：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-conf">input {
  # 接收Filebeat发来的日志
  beats {
    port =&gt; 5044
  }
  
  # 也可以接收TCP发来的日志
  tcp {
    port =&gt; 5000
    codec =&gt; json
  }
}

filter {
  # 解析JSON格式日志
  if [message] =~ /^\{.*\}$/ {
    json {
      source =&gt; "message"
    }
  }
  
  # 解析时间戳
  date {
    match =&gt; ["timestamp", "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS", "ISO8601"]
    target =&gt; "@timestamp"
  }
  
  # 添加自定义字段
  mutate {
    add_field =&gt; { "env" =&gt; "production" }
  }
}

output {
  elasticsearch {
    hosts =&gt; ["elasticsearch:9200"]
    index =&gt; "app-logs-%{+YYYY.MM.dd}"
  }
  
  # 调试时可以输出到控制台
  # stdout { codec =&gt; rubydebug }
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>kibana/config/kibana.yml：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">server.host: "0.0.0.0"
server.name: kibana
elasticsearch.hosts: ["http://elasticsearch:9200"]
i18n.locale: "zh-CN"
</code></pre>
<h3 id="35-启动">3.5 启动</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># 设置ES数据目录权限
chown -R 1000:1000 elasticsearch/data

# 调整系统参数（ES需要）
sysctl -w vm.max_map_count=262144
echo "vm.max_map_count=262144" &gt;&gt; /etc/sysctl.conf

# 启动
docker-compose up -d

# 查看状态
docker-compose ps

# 查看日志
docker-compose logs -f
</code></pre>
<h3 id="36-验证">3.6 验证</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># ES健康检查
curl http://localhost:9200/_cluster/health?pretty

# Kibana访问
# 浏览器打开 http://你的IP:5601
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="四配置日志收集">四、配置日志收集</h2>
<h3 id="41-安装filebeat">4.1 安装Filebeat</h3>
<p>在需要收集日志的服务器上安装：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># CentOS
rpm -ivh https://artifacts.elastic.co/downloads/beats/filebeat/filebeat-8.11.0-x86_64.rpm

# Ubuntu
wget https://artifacts.elastic.co/downloads/beats/filebeat/filebeat-8.11.0-amd64.deb
dpkg -i filebeat-8.11.0-amd64.deb

# Docker方式
docker pull docker.elastic.co/beats/filebeat:8.11.0
</code></pre>
<h3 id="42-配置filebeat">4.2 配置Filebeat</h3>
<p><code>/etc/filebeat/filebeat.yml</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">filebeat.inputs:
  # 收集应用日志
  - type: log
    enabled: true
    paths:
      - /var/log/app/*.log
    fields:
      app: my-app
      env: prod
    fields_under_root: true
    
    # 多行日志合并（Java堆栈）
    multiline.pattern: '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}'
    multiline.negate: true
    multiline.match: after
  
  # 收集Nginx日志
  - type: log
    enabled: true
    paths:
      - /var/log/nginx/access.log
    fields:
      app: nginx
      type: access
    fields_under_root: true

  # 收集系统日志
  - type: log
    enabled: true
    paths:
      - /var/log/messages
      - /var/log/secure
    fields:
      app: system
    fields_under_root: true

# 输出到Logstash
output.logstash:
  hosts: ["ELK服务器IP:5044"]

# 如果直接输出到ES
# output.elasticsearch:
#   hosts: ["ELK服务器IP:9200"]
#   index: "filebeat-%{+yyyy.MM.dd}"

# 日志处理器
processors:
  - add_host_metadata: ~
  - add_cloud_metadata: ~
</code></pre>
<h3 id="43-启动filebeat">4.3 启动Filebeat</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># 测试配置
filebeat test config

# 启动
systemctl enable filebeat
systemctl start filebeat

# 查看状态
systemctl status filebeat
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="五kibana使用指南">五、Kibana使用指南</h2>
<h3 id="51-创建索引模式">5.1 创建索引模式</h3>
<ol>
<li>打开Kibana：<code>http://IP:5601</code></li>
<li>进入 <strong>Stack Management → Index Patterns</strong></li>
<li>点击 <strong>Create index pattern</strong></li>
<li>输入 <code>app-logs-*</code></li>
<li>选择时间字段 <code>@timestamp</code></li>
</ol>
<h3 id="52-日志搜索discover">5.2 日志搜索（Discover）</h3>
<p>进入 <strong>Discover</strong>：</p>
<pre><code># 搜索包含ERROR的日志
message: ERROR

# 搜索特定应用
app: my-app AND level: ERROR

# 时间范围内的错误
level: ERROR AND @timestamp &gt;= "2024-01-01"

# 组合查询
(level: ERROR OR level: WARN) AND app: my-app AND NOT message: "expected error"
</code></pre>
<h3 id="53-常用搜索技巧">5.3 常用搜索技巧</h3>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>需求</th>
<th>查询语法</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>包含关键词</td>
<td><code>message: "OutOfMemory"</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>排除关键词</td>
<td><code>NOT message: "health check"</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>某个字段等于</td>
<td><code>level: ERROR</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>某个字段存在</td>
<td><code>_exists_: traceId</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>正则匹配</td>
<td><code>message: /.*Exception.*/</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>范围查询</td>
<td><code>response_time: [100 TO 500]</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>通配符</td>
<td><code>message: *timeout*</code></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3 id="54-创建可视化图表">5.4 创建可视化图表</h3>
<p><strong>场景：统计每小时的错误数量</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>进入 <strong>Visualize → Create visualization</strong></li>
<li>选择 <strong>Lens</strong> 或 <strong>Aggregation based → Line</strong></li>
<li>配置：
<ul>
<li>Y轴：Count</li>
<li>X轴：@timestamp（Date Histogram，间隔1小时）</li>
<li>过滤：level: ERROR</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>场景：错误类型分布饼图</strong></p>
<ol>
<li>选择 <strong>Pie Chart</strong></li>
<li>Slice by：Terms → error_type</li>
<li>Size by：Count</li>
</ol>
<h3 id="55-创建dashboard">5.5 创建Dashboard</h3>
<p>把多个可视化组合成仪表盘：</p>
<ol>
<li>进入 <strong>Dashboard → Create dashboard</strong></li>
<li>添加已创建的可视化</li>
<li>调整布局</li>
<li>保存</li>
</ol>
<p>推荐的Dashboard组成：</p>
<ul>
<li>日志总量趋势图</li>
<li>错误数量趋势图</li>
<li>错误类型分布</li>
<li>响应时间分布</li>
<li>各服务日志量对比</li>
<li>最近错误列表</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2 id="六logstash高级配置">六、Logstash高级配置</h2>
<h3 id="61-解析nginx日志">6.1 解析Nginx日志</h3>
<pre><code class="language-conf">input {
  beats {
    port =&gt; 5044
  }
}

filter {
  if [fields][type] == "nginx-access" {
    grok {
      match =&gt; { "message" =&gt; '%{IPORHOST:client_ip} - %{DATA:user} \[%{HTTPDATE:timestamp}\] "%{WORD:method} %{URIPATHPARAM:request} HTTP/%{NUMBER:http_version}" %{NUMBER:status} %{NUMBER:bytes} "%{DATA:referrer}" "%{DATA:user_agent}"' }
    }
    
    date {
      match =&gt; ["timestamp", "dd/MMM/yyyy:HH:mm:ss Z"]
      target =&gt; "@timestamp"
    }
    
    geoip {
      source =&gt; "client_ip"
      target =&gt; "geoip"
    }
    
    useragent {
      source =&gt; "user_agent"
      target =&gt; "ua"
    }
    
    mutate {
      convert =&gt; {
        "status" =&gt; "integer"
        "bytes" =&gt; "integer"
      }
      remove_field =&gt; ["message", "timestamp"]
    }
  }
}

output {
  if [fields][type] == "nginx-access" {
    elasticsearch {
      hosts =&gt; ["elasticsearch:9200"]
      index =&gt; "nginx-access-%{+YYYY.MM.dd}"
    }
  }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="62-解析java日志">6.2 解析Java日志</h3>
<pre><code class="language-conf">filter {
  if [fields][app] == "java-app" {
    # 解析标准格式：2024-01-01 12:00:00.123 [thread] LEVEL class - message
    grok {
      match =&gt; { "message" =&gt; "%{TIMESTAMP_ISO8601:timestamp} \[%{DATA:thread}\] %{LOGLEVEL:level} %{DATA:class} - %{GREEDYDATA:log_message}" }
    }
    
    date {
      match =&gt; ["timestamp", "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS"]
      target =&gt; "@timestamp"
    }
    
    # 提取异常类型
    if [level] == "ERROR" {
      grok {
        match =&gt; { "log_message" =&gt; "%{DATA:exception_class}:%{GREEDYDATA:exception_message}" }
        tag_on_failure =&gt; []
      }
    }
  }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="63-日志脱敏">6.3 日志脱敏</h3>
<pre><code class="language-conf">filter {
  # 脱敏手机号
  mutate {
    gsub =&gt; [
      "message", "1[3-9]\d{9}", "***phone***"
    ]
  }
  
  # 脱敏身份证
  mutate {
    gsub =&gt; [
      "message", "\d{17}[\dXx]", "***idcard***"
    ]
  }
  
  # 脱敏银行卡
  mutate {
    gsub =&gt; [
      "message", "\d{16,19}", "***bankcard***"
    ]
  }
}
</code></pre>
<hr>
<h2 id="七告警配置">七、告警配置</h2>
<h3 id="71-使用elastalert">7.1 使用Elastalert</h3>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># 安装
pip install elastalert2

# 配置 config.yaml
rules_folder: /opt/elastalert/rules
es_host: localhost
es_port: 9200
</code></pre>
<p>告警规则 <code>rules/error_alert.yaml</code>：</p>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">name: "应用错误告警"
type: frequency
index: app-logs-*

# 5分钟内超过10次ERROR就告警
num_events: 10
timeframe:
  minutes: 5

filter:
  - term:
      level: ERROR

alert:
  - dingtalk

dingtalk_webhook: "https://oapi.dingtalk.com/robot/send?access_token=xxx"
dingtalk_msgtype: "markdown"
</code></pre>
<h3 id="72-使用kibana自带告警需订阅">7.2 使用Kibana自带告警（需订阅）</h3>
<p>进入 <strong>Stack Management → Rules and Connectors</strong></p>
<hr>
<h2 id="八异地服务器日志收集">八、异地服务器日志收集</h2>
<p>公司有多个机房，服务器分布在不同网络，怎么把日志集中到一个ELK？</p>
<h3 id="方案1公网暴露端口不推荐">方案1：公网暴露端口（不推荐）</h3>
<p>把Logstash的5044端口暴露到公网，安全风险大。</p>
<h3 id="方案2vpn">方案2：VPN</h3>
<p>在各机房部署VPN客户端，打通到ELK服务器的网络。</p>
<p>缺点：</p>
<ul>
<li>配置复杂</li>
<li>经常断连</li>
<li>影响日志实时性</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="方案3sd-wan组网我在用的">方案3：SD-WAN组网（我在用的）</h3>
<p>用星空组网把所有服务器组到一个虚拟网络：</p>
<pre><code class="language-bash"># 在ELK服务器
curl -sSL https://down.starvpn.cn/linux.sh | bash
xkcli login your_token &amp;&amp; xkcli up
# 虚拟IP: 192.168.188.10

# 在各机房的服务器
# 同样操作，获得虚拟IP
</code></pre>
<p>Filebeat配置直接用虚拟IP：</p>
<pre><code class="language-yaml">output.logstash:
  hosts: ["192.168.188.10:5044"]
</code></pre>
<p><strong>效果：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>配置简单，5分钟搞定</li>
<li>延迟低（P2P直连）</li>
<li>稳定，用了3个月没断过</li>
<li>安全，流量加密</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2 id="九性能优化">九、性能优化</h2>
<h3 id="91-es优化">9.1 ES优化</h3>
<p><strong>索引生命周期管理（ILM）：</strong></p>
<pre><code class="language-json">PUT _ilm/policy/logs-policy
{
  "policy": {
    "phases": {
      "hot": {
        "actions": {
          "rollover": {
            "max_size": "50GB",
            "max_age": "1d"
          }
        }
      },
      "warm": {
        "min_age": "7d",
        "actions": {
          "shrink": { "number_of_shards": 1 },
          "forcemerge": { "max_num_segments": 1 }
        }
      },
      "delete": {
        "min_age": "30d",
        "actions": { "delete": {} }
      }
    }
  }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="92-logstash优化">9.2 Logstash优化</h3>
<pre><code class="language-yaml"># logstash.yml
pipeline.workers: 4          # CPU核心数
pipeline.batch.size: 1000    # 批处理大小
pipeline.batch.delay: 50     # 批处理等待时间(ms)
</code></pre>
<h3 id="93-filebeat优化">9.3 Filebeat优化</h3>
<pre><code class="language-yaml"># 批量发送
output.logstash:
  hosts: ["192.168.188.10:5044"]
  bulk_max_size: 2048
  
# 队列设置
queue.mem:
  events: 4096
  flush.min_events: 2048
  flush.timeout: 1s
</code></pre>

<h2 id="十效果对比">十、效果对比</h2>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>指标</th>
<th>传统方式</th>
<th>ELK</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>查日志耗时</td>
<td>10-30分钟</td>
<td>几秒</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>跨服务器查询</td>
<td>手动逐台查</td>
<td>一次搜索全部</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>历史日志</td>
<td>需要下载</td>
<td>直接查</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>统计分析</td>
<td>写脚本</td>
<td>点几下</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>告警</td>
<td>无</td>
<td>自动</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><strong>实际收益：</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>排查问题效率提升10倍</li>
<li>终于能回答"昨天有多少报错"了</li>
<li>定位问题从"猜"变成"查"</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2 id="总结">总结</h2>
<p>ELK搭建不难，难的是：</p>
<ol>
<li>日志格式要规范（JSON最好）</li>
<li>字段要统一（各应用约定好）</li>
<li>索引要管理（不然磁盘爆炸）</li>
<li>网络要打通（异地服务器用组网）</li>
</ol>
<p>建议先从单个应用开始，跑顺了再推广到其他应用。</p>
<p>有问题评论区交流~</p>
<pre><code>
</code></pre>
